reason: Aineisto perustuu lähinnä Hacker News -kommentteihin ja yksittäisiin käyttäjäkokemuksiin. Varsinaisen VS Code -muutoksen, Microsoftin kannan, korjauksen sisällön tai ongelman laajuuden varmistavat tiedot puuttuvat, joten 250 sanan uutinen vaatisi vahvistamattomien väitteiden yleistämistä.

packet.headline_seed: VS Code inserting 'Co-Authored-by Copilot' into commits regardless of usage

what: VS Code inserting 'Co-Authored-by Copilot' into commits regardless of usage

clean_source_blocks.text: Article URL: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/310226 Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47989883 Points: 230 # Comments: 90

Update: I can personally confirm this: on multiple recent commits I hand-wrote every commit message and never touched Copilot while coding, yet there it is — Co-authored-by: Copilot copilot@github.com — injected anyway. At the very least, people who write their own commit messages in the vscode git
I have "chat.disableAIFeatures": true and co-authored by copilot still gets inserted into most commits. This is absolutely unacceptable.
Now I know why random commits of mine were suddenly being "co-authored by copilot" despite not using copilot with that commit. I just don't get the point of this at all.
